pr_body:
The cluster listener spots the instances when the master has been upgraded to the most recent code version, along with non-master nodes, but some nodes are missing cluster features

Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/109254
pr_title: Add a cluster listener to fix missing cluster features after upgrade
pr_comment: This doesn't have an integration test attached, as our existing upgrade tests don't have non-master nodes in them.
Hi @thecoop, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment: Why can this be removed in v9? Is it because you can't upgrade to v9 from versions prior to 8.13 anyway?
You can only upgrade to v9 from v8.last, which will definitely have cluster features. So this won't be needed once its not possible to upgrade from a cluster that doesnt know about features

Why is this needed?
Should not we merge the maps in any case?

This is more being extra-safe - in the case the node has left and re-joined in the meantime it will have the features in there already, which may be different to those that were queried before the node was shut down.

This is for the case this runs more times, right? What are the cases? 
Retry for failure, but also more nodes joined?
Would it be possible to have a test for this?
I've added a test for overlapping operations
Why would users want to change it?
Fair enough. I don't know TBH.
Unrelated to this PR, but should we already create @UpdateForV10?
Probably - or just create it as part of the v9 migration
